description: Four pingable LFOs, each given its period by tapping or pinging and shaped by its own skew control

params.text: Sets that channel's shape: a falling ramp fully anticlockwise, a triangle at centre, a rising ramp fully clockwise, and at the very bottom of the travel a short pluck and then a trigger
Tap it twice to set that channel's period; the LFO then runs at the time between the taps
Lets that channel's output through; with it off the output is held at 0V

inputs.text: Two edges here set that channel's period, and the LFO then runs at the time between them
Adds to that channel's SKEW knob, 10V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
An edge here sends that channel's cycle back to the start

outputs.text: That channel's LFO, 0V to 10V unless the menu's output range is changed, and 0V while the channel's ON button is off

notes: The ping and reset jacks are read as plain true or false against zero, so any voltage that is not exactly 0V counts as high, negative ones included.
menu: Fire On Unmute ch1 — when on, turning channel 1's ON button back on restarts that channel's cycle
Fire On Unmute ch2 — when on, turning channel 2's ON button back on restarts that channel's cycle

Fire On Unmute ch4 — when on, turning channel 4's ON button back on restarts that channel's cycle
